items.title: Israel kills senior member of Hamas's military wing in Gaza strike
items.summary: The Israeli military said on Sunday its forces had killed a senior member of Hamas's military wing in Gaza. The militant group confirmed the death of Samir Abu Younis, the commander of its Rafah brigade, adding that he played a prominent role in planning the October 7, 2023 attacks.

items.title: Megaspeed says alleged Chinese spy, Alice Huang, left company last year
items.summary: The cloud computing company with ties to Nvidia, Megaspeed, has said that Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese spy, left the company in 2025. Huang is at the heart of an international corporate scandal and alleged to have had an affair with former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang

items.title: Mysterious object in space: Could it be a Soviet probe missing for 40 years?
items.summary: The object, known as "1998 KY26", about 11 metres wide, is moving near Earth; yet something other than the Sun's or Earth's gravity seems to affect its path and speed.
